ESLint v10.0.0 is a major release of ESLint, and as such, has several breaking changes that you need to be aware of. This guide is intended to walk you through the breaking changes.

To help with this migration, ESLint provides migration codemods to automate many of the changes described in this guide. All official ESLint codemods are available in the [eslint/codemods](https://github.com/eslint/codemods) repository and through the [Codemod Registry](https://app.codemod.com/registry?q=scope%3Aeslint).

---
title: Migrating to v4.0.0
---

ESLint v4.0.0 is the fourth major version release. We have made several breaking changes in this release; however, we expect that most of the changes will only affect a very small percentage of users. This guide is intended to walk you through the changes.

The lists below are ordered roughly by the number of users each change is expected to affect, where the first items are expected to affect the most users.

request.instructions: The documents are sections of the documentation of ONE open-source project at one commit. Report a conflict only when two sections make incompatible statements about the SAME option, flag, default value, limit, version requirement, or behavior, for the same product version and scope. These are NOT conflicts: values of different options; example values in code samples that merely override a default; statements explicitly scoped to an older version or to migration history; one section giving more detail than the other; different defaults that the text ties to different contexts (per-route vs global, dev vs build, agent mode vs server mode).
